Talent0_2Ability.name: EVA-01 Pilot
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: Can perform <buf ID=900088>[Synchronization]</buf> with ST. After initiating combat, if possessing <color=#F74848>3</color> or more buffs, triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>. Cannot move before attacking. Can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

Talent3_5Ability.name: EVA-01 Pilot
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects: Can perform <buf ID=900088>[Synchronization]</buf> with ST. After initiating combat, if possessing <color=#F74848>3</color> or more buffs, triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>. Cannot move before attacking. Can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.\nWhen deployed, <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> is increased by <color=#F74848>10%</color>. At start of action, if [Rei] or [Asuka] is present, randomly gains <color=#F74848>1</color> buff, lasting <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

200001.name: CEC 1
200001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, use Assault Weapons to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

201402.name: Penetrating Shot
201402.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.1x</color> DMG. This attack ignores any DMG Reduction effects on the target. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking.

201403.name: Steady Operation
201403.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if there are no other enemy units within <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles of the target, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

201404.name: Suppression Spray
201404.describe: Uses a Heavy Machine Gun to attack all targets within a <range type=1>3-tile line</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.7x</color> AoE DMG. For each target hit, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> random buff after combat. Can gain up to <color=#F74848>3</color> buffs, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

201405.name: Unyielding
201405.SpecificEffects: Immune to <buf ID=7101505>[Crash]</buf> and <buf ID=900035>[Timidity]</buf> effects.

201406.name: Positron Loaded
201406.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.5x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking. This attack ignores any DMG Reduction effects on the target. If <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> is greater than or equal to <color=#F74848>75%</color>, this attack is guaranteed to hit.

201407.name: Overlimit Mode
201407.SpecificEffects: At start of action, if possessing <color=#F74848>4</color> or more buffs, AP Cost <color=#F74848>-1</color> for the first active attack this turn, down to a minimum of <color=#F74848>1</color>.

201408.name: Kinetic Revival
201408.describe: Consumes all dispellable buffs. Recovers <color=#F74848>1</color> AP for each consumed, up to a maximum of <color=#F74848>4</color> AP. Can continue action with remaining Movement.

201409.name: Charged Shot
201409.describe: Uses a Heavy Machine Gun to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG. For each buff possessed, DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

200011.name: CEC 2
200011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

200021.name: CEC 3
200021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

200022.name: Power Innovation 2
200022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

200033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
200033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if no active attacks were used this turn, can move an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles.

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
Before actively attacking without having moved, can trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.
Only triggers if no other <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> effect is triggered this turn.

201431.name: Overloaded Mode 1
201431.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> is greater than or equal to <color=#F74848>65%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.

201434.name: Overloaded Mode 2
201434.SpecificEffects: After initiating combat, randomly duplicates <color=#F74848>1</color> dispellable buff from the target. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

201435.name: Overloaded Mode 3
201435.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> is greater than or equal to <color=#F74848>80%</color>, at end of action, restores <color=#F74848>5%</color> Max HP for each buff possessed, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>. Cannot repair destroyed parts.

201436.name: Overloaded Mode 4
201436.SpecificEffects:
<buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> cap increased to <color=#F74848>400%</color>. Effects exceeding <color=#F74848>100%</color> are reduced by <color=#F74848>50%</color>.
When <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> is greater than or equal to <color=#F74848>100%</color>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+30%</color> and Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
When HP is below <color=#F74848>20%</color>, <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> immediately increases by <color=#F74848>50%</color>. This effect can only trigger once per deployment.

201444.name: Fitting Reorganization 2
201444.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if the target cannot retaliate, randomly extends the <buf ID=900078>[Turns Left]</buf> of <color=#F74848>1</color> buff on self by <color=#F74848>1</color> turn after combat.

201445.name: Fitting Reorganization 3
201445.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> correction effect increased by <color=#F74848>50%</color>, until fixed at <color=#F74848>100%</color>.

201446.name: Fitting Reorganization 4
201446.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> reaches <color=#F74848>100%</color>, Heavy Machine Gun and Sniper Rifle Range <color=#F74848>+1</color>, and Final DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.
